name: table-3d-model-picker-compact
title: Compact the table 3D model picker
description: Reduce catalog row height and improve scroll alignment without changing model selection behavior.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Screenshot audit found oversized desktop catalog rows and partial rows at scroll boundaries. The selection/filter callbacks and model data contract are already correct; the smallest fix is a desktop-only compact layout in the existing final content-safety stylesheet.
